messages.text: Spike in 5xx errors in the last hour. Pattern looks like a specific endpoint and payload size. Want to dig in together?
Send me the aggregated series—status code, endpoint, timestamp. I'll run a quick regression to see if it's correlated with request size.
Here's the export. I also flagged 12 stack traces that mention OOM. Same time window.
OOM plus large payloads fits. Can you pull request body size distribution for that endpoint? I'll check for a threshold.
Done. Median is 4KB, but the tail has requests up to 50MB. No rate limit on that route.
That's the signal. I'll draft a short report: recommend payload limit and add monitoring on that dimension. Your logs made the diagnosis straightforward.
Glad it helped. I'm better at finding the needle; you're better at explaining why the haystack matters.
We're complementary. Next time you see an anomaly, ping me before escalating. We can often turn it into a preventive metric.
Deal. I'll keep an eye on the tail. You keep an eye on the model.
